comment: Remediation v2 item 1.4 (2026-08-02). Every pca_runs artifact is pinned to the methodology GENERATION it was produced under, so an older-generation artifact can never be re-published as-is: truthbot.publish.consistency.check_run_artifacts asserts the current-generation invariants (S5 cap, era, zero fact-check URLs) only over runs labeled current_generation and permanently reports the rest as legacy. Generations classified by inspection: no 'evidence' key => no-evidence; evidence with no Political tier => pre-s5-tiering; Political present but per-sid counts exceed the <=3 cap => pre-s5-cap; cap respected + role axis + era fail-closed => v2.3-role-axis-s5cap.

generations.v2.3-role-axis-s5cap: S5 political tier + <=3 cap + role axis + era fail-closed
generations.pre-s5-cap: S5 political tier present but no per-claim <=3 saturation cap; obama_2014 runs carry rescue-leg era violations
generations.pre-s5-tiering: no S5 political tier existed — every .gov host classified top-tier Government; early runs also predate the fact-check exclusion
generations.no-evidence: artifact stores rows/claims only, no evidence key — evidence packs were not persisted
